message: Field "Post.count": native type "@db.Long" is not supported by the Prisma 6 MongoDB contract source; only @db.ObjectId is. Remove it: the stored BSON type then follows the field type.
Field "Post.title": native type "@db.String" is not supported by the Prisma 6 MongoDB contract source; only @db.ObjectId is. Remove it: the stored BSON type then follows the field type.
Field "Post.number": @db.ObjectId is only supported on a String field, and this field is "Int". Remove @db.ObjectId, or change the field type to String.
